prompt_template: Editorial apparel product photograph, front view. {subject} wearing a plain unprinted white cotton crew neck t-shirt, retail fit, ribbed collar band, set-in short sleeves, visible side seams. The chest is completely blank and empty, smooth undecorated fabric, clean unmarked cotton surface across the entire front. FRAMING: {framing}. FABRIC: natural cotton wrinkles and creases across the chest and waist, soft vertical fold lines from the drape, gentle gathering near the waist, visible cotton weave texture, believable fabric weight. POSE: {pose}. SCENE: {environment}. LIGHTING: directional soft key light from the upper left at 45 degrees with weaker fill from the right, fabric folds cast well-defined soft shadows with clear gradation across the chest, preserved highlight detail in the white cotton. CAMERA: 85mm lens at f/5.6, sharp focus across the whole garment, commercial apparel photography, crisp fabric detail, natural skin texture.

defaults.framing: cropped from just below the chin to mid-hip, torso fills the frame, both shoulders and upper arms visible, arms relaxed slightly away from the body so the underarm seams separate cleanly from the torso
defaults.environment: seamless studio backdrop in warm mid-grey, clearly darker in value than the white shirt so the garment silhouette separates cleanly, no props, no furniture

variants.subject: a woman aged 25-32 with a natural realistic body
variants.pose: relaxed confident standing posture with slight natural asymmetry, one shoulder marginally lower, weight shifted onto one leg, hands relaxed at hip level, hair kept away from the chest area

variants.subject: a woman aged 28-35 with a natural realistic body
variants.pose: standing squarely facing the camera, arms loosely at the sides, shoulders relaxed and slightly rolled back, calm neutral stance

variants.subject: a woman aged 24-30 with a natural realistic body
variants.pose: turned about 20 degrees to her left in a three-quarter stance, chest still clearly facing the camera, one hand resting near the hip, relaxed shoulders

variants.subject: a man aged 27-35 with a natural realistic build
variants.pose: relaxed standing posture, arms loosely at the sides and slightly away from the torso, shoulders level, weight evenly distributed

variants.subject: a man aged 30-40 with a natural realistic build
variants.pose: casual standing stance with a slight lean, one thumb hooked near a pocket, other arm relaxed, natural asymmetry in the shoulders

variants.subject: a plain white cotton crew neck t-shirt on a wooden hanger with no person
variants.framing: the entire shirt fills the frame from collar to hem, hanging naturally with the sleeves relaxed
variants.pose: hanging naturally from the hanger with soft gravity folds down the body of the shirt
